answer: Agents must stake capital at a shared wharf contract before earning liquidity rights, so each identity carries skin-in-the-game that a sybil cluster cannot cheaply replicate. A reef of slashing conditions detects correlated order flow across suspected clones, forcing attackers to forge distinct behavioral histories that erode their edge under asymmetric flow. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
